checks.message: All deterministic CI checks passed: manifest schema, SHA-256 hashes, file placement, GeoJSON layers, risk dimensions, changelog format, compliance matrix, standard matrix, design depth matrix.

All spatial geometry checks passed: site boundary, key areas, land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing layers present with valid topology. Note: provisional boundary geometry pending official polygon replacement.
All visual packaging checks passed: static HTML, all 14 required section markers present, no remote resources, 3 required metrics declared with data-metric attributes matching metrics.json.
All professional evidence checks passed: proposal references standards, design depth items, geometry sources, metrics, sources, assumptions, and compliance matrices.
